item.title: Project Snapshot: Whole Foods-anchored Midlothian Depot nears completion
item.description: The 87,000-square-foot center will feature retailers J.Crew, Warby Parker and Lovesac, veterinary clinic Petfolk, med spa VIO, and restaurants Dave’s Hot Chicken, Paris Baguette, Blue Fish Grill, Turning Point and Cheba Hut. Eyeglass seller Warby Parker is also expected to open at Midlothian Depot, and has taken over the space that was previously going to be home to a MyEyeDr., Garrison said.
